version: REVTeX 4.2f distribution, official APS apstemplate sample (header 4.2a), with prx option
license: Official APS REVTeX sample template; retain APS copyright and REVTeX README restrictions. REVTeX class/styles are not bundled and must come from the user's TeX installation under LPPL 1.3c.

style.audience: A broad audience of physicists across pure, applied and interdisciplinary physics
style.narrative: Concise, self-contained account of an innovative result with clear long-term significance and context for non-specialists
style.structure: Abstract; accessible introduction; model or methods; central results; discussion; conclusion; appendices or supplemental material
style.citation_rules: Use APS REVTeX bibliography style and provide complete article titles where possible
style.length_rules: PRX has no fixed four-page limit; keep the manuscript concise while providing enough context and technical support for broad readership
